name: Product Navbar
summary: A marketing top bar with dropdown menus of icon links, plain links and right-hand actions, collapsing into one disclosure panel on phones.
useWhen: A marketing site with several product or solution groups to link to
Needing hover and keyboard dropdowns without a menu library
avoidWhen: An app shell needs persistent navigation; use a sidebar from app-interface instead
A small page with a floating action; app-interface/floating-menu fits better
